limitations: Fixed full-support i.i.d. sources and fixed finite alphabet; no variance, concentration, growing alphabet, vanishing mass, or typical-word theorem; equivalent unindexed literature remains possible.
scientific_integrity: Proof uses an exact greedy-waiting Fourier transform and a uniform multidimensional simple-pole/Gaussian asymptotic; finite checks independently test coefficients but are not infinite proofs.
title: Alphabet-codimension law for distinct scattered Abelian squares in random words
